transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Before I sign Thursday's airlift manifest, I need to confirm whether operations, signal, and medical have any changes to your standard pallet requests. The contracted aircraft has capacity for 23 standard pallets, and the normal weekly request totals 18 pallets — 8 engineering, 5 communications batteries, and 5 medical. Please let me know if anything has changed so I can finalize the manifest and loading instructions.
